name: KeyBindings
description: A collection of KeyBinding objects that represent the custom key assignments in the current context. Custom key assignments are made in the Customize Keyboard dialog box.
remarks: Use the KeyBindings property to return the KeyBindings collection. The following example inserts after the selection the command name and key combination for each item in the KeyBindings collection. Use the Add method to add a KeyBinding object to the KeyBindings collection. The following example adds the CTRL+ALT+H key combination to the Heading 1 style in the active document. Use KeyBindings (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single KeyBinding object. The following example displays the command associated with the first KeyBinding object in the KeyBindings collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified KeyBindings object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of key bindings in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Context
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the storage location of the specified key binding. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual KeyBinding object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(KeyCategory As WdKeyCategory, Command As String, KeyCode As Long, [KeyCode2 As Variant], [CommandParameter As Variant]) As KeyBinding
methods.description: Returns a KeyBinding object that represents a new shortcut key for a macro, built-in command, font, AutoText entry, style, or symbol.

parameters.name: KeyCategory
parameters.description: The category of the key assignment.

parameters.name: Command
parameters.description: The command that the specified key combination executes.

parameters.name: KeyCode
parameters.description: A key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

parameters.name: KeyCode2
parameters.description: A second key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

parameters.name: CommandParameter
parameters.description: Additional text, if any, required for the command specified by Command. For details, see the Remarks section below.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all the customized key assignments and restores the original Microsoft Word shortcut key assignments.

methods.name: Key
methods.signature: Key(KeyCode As Long, [KeyCode2 As Variant]) As KeyBinding
methods.description: Returns a KeyBinding object that represents the specified custom key combination.

parameters.name: KeyCode
parameters.description: A key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.

parameters.name: KeyCode2
parameters.description: A second key you specify by using one of the WdKey constants.
